export_mjcf_model_as_zip: export a MuJoCo MJCF model and all its assets to a .zip file in a given output directory
export_mjcf_with_custom_name: export an MJCF model to a zip file using a custom model name instead of the default
export_mjcf_with_precision: export an MJCF model to a zip file with a custom floating point precision setting
export_mjcf_with_zero_threshold: export an MJCF model to a zip file treating small floats below a threshold as zero
review_export_with_assets_as_zip: review the export_with_assets_as_zip function to understand how it bundles MJCF models and assets into a zip
